evidence.text: Pictograph of one person following another.
相聽也。从二人。凡从之屬皆从从。
相聽也。从二人。凡从之屬皆从从。
{"japanese_kun": "したが.う したが.える より", "japanese_on": "ショウ ジュウ ジュ"}
Originally a pictograph of one person following another (从).  Later the 彳 and 止 components were added to indicate movement.

Originally written as 从. Now phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *zloŋ, *zloŋ, *zloŋs): semantic 辵 (“walk”) + phonetic 从 (OC *zloŋ, “follow”).
Etymology not certain. Perhaps cognate with Tibetan རྫོང་བ (rdzong ba, “to dispatch; to dismiss”) (Schuessler, 2007). Alternatively, compare Tibetan སྟོངས་པ (stongs pa, “to accompany”), or perhaps 送 (OC *sloːŋs, “to escort; to send”).
Pronunciation 2 is a derivation of pronunciation 1.
